metadata_note: Exact backend model/version and sampling settings were not exposed by the subagent interface. No overrides were requested.
execution: One fresh responding context per scenario; the clarification follow-up reuses its original context. Respondents read only the skill and their prompt. No retrieval or tools during composition; a tool saved the completed response afterward.
reviewer: Primary Codex agent, not human expert review. The user review of prior records is not counted as an independent model rerun.
limitations: The validation example contains a documented overstatement about recommendation wording.
The deployment rewrite relies on the initial dispatch state in its supplied context.
No full dictionary compliance or real-system validation.
